findings.desc: stall_resolution_set is unreachable through the real CLI in both phases it is declared for: packages/main/src/core/config.ts DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.DEV and DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.REVIEW (and the global "*" bucket) never list stall_resolution_set, even though command-policy.ts declares allowedPhases:[DEV,REVIEW] and command-catalog.ts registers its schema. cli-engine.ts gates every CLI invocation through isCommandAllowed(cmd, activeStory.phase, config.phaseTools) BEFORE dispatch, so lattice stall_resolution_set is rejected with Command not available in <phase> phase in the exact two phases (DEV, REVIEW) the feature exists for. Reproduced live against this very story (B-7813, currently REVIEW): node bin/lattice.js stall_resolution_set {storyId:B-7813,action:authorize_continuation,reason:...} -> exit 1, Command stall_resolution_set is not available in REVIEW phase. The refusal prompt CHK-001 wires into getGuardFailureReason (core/review-convergence.ts buildStallAdjudicationPrompt/buildStallCeilingPrompt) literally tells the operator to run stall_resolution_set, which is a dead end. Root cause of the miss: lifecycle-registry-contract.ts checkCommandDimension only checks that DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS is a SUBSET of what command-policy allows (never grants more), never the converse (that every command-policy allowedPhases entry is actually reachable via DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS), so node packages/main/dist/tasks/lifecycle-registry-contract.js reports PASS despite this gap. The RED-first smoke (tasks/review-budget-stall-adjudication-smoke.ts) also never catches it because it calls the stall.stall_resolution_set(...) handler function directly, bypassing cli-engine.ts entirely. Fix: add stall_resolution_set to DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.DEV and .REVIEW in packages/main/src/core/config.ts (or the global * bucket), and add a converse cross-check to lifecycle-registry-contract.ts so this direction of drift is caught mechanically going forward.
findings.resolvedReason: a72c3e5308: added stall_resolution_set to DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.DEV and .REVIEW in core/config.ts (peer of scope_shrinkage_decision_set/finding_cluster). Verified: node bin/lattice.js stall_resolution_set against B-7813 in REVIEW is no longer phase-blocked; lifecycle-registry-contract PASS.

findings.desc: CHK-002:happy:0 and CHK-002:edge:0 declare verificationIntent.type="cli" (an operator running stall_resolution_set via the real CLI), but the recorded verificationEvidence (kind=manual_transcript, both pinned to review-budget-stall-adjudication-smoke.js) never crosses the CLI boundary: the smoke calls stall.stall_resolution_set(...) directly via createStallAdjudicationHandlers(ctx), bypassing cli-engine.ts/isCommandAllowed entirely. Independently reproduced (node bin/lattice.js stall_resolution_set against this live story, currently REVIEW): exit 1, "Command stall_resolution_set is not available in REVIEW phase" -- confirms lattice-review-concept B-7813:F-001 (stall_resolution_set missing from DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.DEV/.REVIEW in core/config.ts). So the declared cli-type intent was never satisfiable by genuine CLI-level verification, and the manual_transcript evidence mislabels a direct in-process handler call as CLI evidence. Same root cause blocks CHK-001/003 operator recovery too: buildStallAdjudicationPrompt/buildStallCeilingPrompt literally instruct the operator to run stall_resolution_set, which is a dead end in both phases it exists for. Fix: once F-001 lands (stall_resolution_set added to phaseTools), re-run/replace this evidence with a genuine CLI-level transcript (spawn lattice stall_resolution_set as a child process) for the cli-typed intents, or downgrade the declared type to logic and add real CLI-reachability coverage separately.

This is exactly the command the new blocking prompts (core/review-convergence.ts buildStallAdjudicationPrompt/buildStallCeilingPrompt, surfaced via getGuardFailureReason) instruct the operator to run — so the entire CHK-002/CHK-003 clearing mechanism (authorize_continuation/replan/escalate_root_cause/resolve_findings/declare_unreachable/override_budget) is inoperable via the real CLI today; only the RED-first smoke exercises it because it calls the handler function directly, bypassing cli-engine.ts isCommandAllowed entirely. Corroborates/aligns with lattice-review-concept finding B-7813:F-001 (same root cause, same fix: add stall_resolution_set to DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS.DEV and .REVIEW in core/config.ts). Filed independently under the quality lane because it is precisely the promised-but-undelivered failure mode the Closing Self-Check requires flagging: the guard's own printed remediation text is a dead end for a real operator.
